column1: # What a change touches: which checks scripts/mdmm-check.sh runs for it (doc/release/DEV-CYCLE.md). One row per path
# pattern, read top to bottom: the first row a path matches is the one for it.
#   path      a glob on the path from the checkout (* any run of characters, also /)
#   ctest     unit tests: a ctest -R regex, or L:<label> (L:Page: the node page tests), or "all" (every unit test)
#   firmware  firmware tests for the branch check (ctest -R regex; they need the ROMs)
#   page      page journeys (scripts/mdmm-page.mjs selector: md-*, mm-*, * both editors)
#   machine   machine journeys for the branch check (scripts/mdmm-journeys.sh --tier machine selector, ROMs needed)
#   goldens   yes: the change can change the sound (emulation code): the playing goldens run
# A path no row matches runs every unit test and every page journey (the safe default).
# --- the core and the machines' models (no emulator)
# --- the plug-in (JUCE, the window, the host side)
# --- what holds no code the tests run
